entities.name: Joanna
entities.description: A screenwriter and author, and Nate's long-standing friend. Through 2022 she finished her first three screenplays, joined a writers group, saw three scripts she contributed to reach the big screen, wrote a book, and by November 2022 was filming her own movie from her road-trip script. She is lactose intolerant and allergic to furred animals, most reptiles and cockroaches, so she keeps no pets. She also hikes, reads, watches dramas and romcoms, and bakes dairy-free desserts.

entities.name: Nate
entities.description: A competitive video gamer and Joanna's long-standing friend. He won his first tournament in January 2022 and by August 2022 was making a living from competitive gaming, including an international title and a Valorant final in November 2022. He keeps turtles and, from May 2022, an adopted dog called Max; he makes dairy-free and vegan desserts, taught them on his own cooking show in September 2022, and started a gaming YouTube channel in November 2022. He dyed his hair purple in April 2022.

entities.name: Nate's turtles

properties.aliases: the turtles, Nate's little dudes, his little guys, his little buddies

entities.description: Nate's pet turtles, never given individual names in the conversation and treated throughout as one household of animals. He had two of them for about three years as of January 2022, gave them a larger tank in August 2022 and added a third in November 2022. They eat vegetables, fruit and insects, have distinct personalities — one adventurous, one reserved — and he walks them, takes them into the kitchen, to the park and once to the beach at Tampa. They are how he stays calm when he is nervous.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: Nate's adopted dog, who joined the household around 20 May 2022. He is full of energy, fills Nate's life with joy, keeps the turtles active, and has doggy playdates with the dog of a couple who live nearby and whom Nate met while walking him.

entities.name: Tilly
entities.description: A dog Joanna had back in Michigan before she developed her animal allergy, which meant the family had to rehome her. Joanna later named the stuffed toy dog Nate gave her after this dog, because the name reminds her of when she could hold an animal without a reaction.

entities.name: Tilly the stuffed dog
entities.description: A stuffed toy dog Nate gave Joanna on 25 May 2022 as a reminder of good vibes. She named it Tilly after the dog she used to have in Michigan, keeps it with her while she writes, and says it helps her stay focused and brings her joy.

entities.name: Joanna's writers group
entities.description: The writers group Joanna joined shortly before 21 April 2022, full of inspirational people who understand her writing and which left her feeling she finally belonged somewhere. She develops the script 'Finding Home' with them, shared her book with them in August 2022 and got great feedback, and made a bookmark for one of the women in the group in October 2022. She also calls it her writing club.

entities.name: Nate's vegan diet group
entities.description: A vegan diet group Nate belongs to. He shared the vegan ice cream he made on 17 June 2022 with its members.

entities.name: Joanna's first screenplay
entities.description: Joanna's first full screenplay, a mix of drama and romance. She finished and printed it on 21 January 2022 after working on it for a long while, felt relief, excitement and anxiety, and submitted it to film festivals hoping a producer or director would pick it up. By 3 June 2022 a major company had sent her a generic rejection letter with no feedback.

entities.name: Joanna's road-trip screenplay
entities.description: Joanna's second screenplay, about a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss who takes a road trip to heal and grow. It is her own story, drawn from personal experience. She began it around 25 February 2022 and had finished it by 18 March 2022, and by 11 November 2022 she was filming it as her own movie, with an actor on set telling her how much she liked the script.

entities.name: Finding Home
entities.description: A script about a girl on a journey to find her true home, which Joanna developed with her writers group from April 2022 and finished by 20 May 2022. She called it her third screenplay and her most personal — about loss, identity and connection — a story she had held for years before finding the courage to write it, and one she wanted to show Nate.

entities.name: Joanna's book
entities.description: A book Joanna started writing around 10 July 2022 after a movie she wrote for did well: a deep, emotional story exploring loss, redemption and forgiveness, and the first book she had tried to publish. She shared it nervously with her writers group in August 2022 and got great feedback, and finished the writing in the week before 6 October 2022 after many late nights and edits.

entities.name: Joanna's Midwestern small-town thriller
entities.description: A script Joanna was inspired to write after her research road trip to Woodhaven in July 2022, where the town's history and a book of local stories and sketches from the 1900s sparked the idea. She said it would be different from her previous work, and by 9 November 2022 described it as a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town and a great creative outlet.

entities.name: Joanna's love-story script
entities.description: A movie script Joanna was writing in November 2022: a love story with many challenges, which she got the idea for from a dream and hoped to get on the big screen. She opened it with a letter her brother wrote her when they were children.

entities.name: Nate's cooking show
entities.description: Nate's own cooking show, on which he taught people vegan ice cream recipes on Monday 12 September 2022. It was nerve-wracking to put himself out there but a blast, and he picked up a few new recipes from it; his favourite dish from the show is coconut milk ice cream.

entities.name: Nate's gaming party
entities.description: A gaming party Nate organised for the weekend of 18 June 2022, inviting tournament friends and old teammates and giving everyone custom controller decorations. Seven people came, six of them said they wanted to do it again the following month, and they played Chess afterwards.

entities.name: Nate's gaming YouTube channel
entities.description: Gaming content for YouTube that Nate began making in November 2022 to entertain people and satisfy his gaming cravings between tournaments, hoping to share his love of gaming and connect with others. He was already studying other creators' videos first, which was also Joanna's advice.

entities.name: Michigan
entities.description: Where Joanna lived earlier in her life and kept a dog called Tilly, before her animal allergy meant the family had to rehome her.

entities.name: Whispering Falls
entities.description: A waterfall Joanna hiked to and photographed in the week before 12 May 2022. She found it peaceful and serene and the rush of the water soothing, and it was one of the trails that made her want to write a drama.

entities.name: Woodhaven
entities.description: A small town in the Midwest that Joanna visited on a research road trip shortly before 10 July 2022. She saw its scenery and historic buildings and found a book from the 1900s of local stories and sketches in its library; the town's past and how much it had changed sparked her next script.

entities.name: the Midwest
entities.description: The American region containing Woodhaven, and the setting of the suspenseful small-town thriller Joanna began writing in 2022.

entities.name: Fort Wayne
entities.description: A place Joanna hiked near in the summer of 2022, where she took the photograph of a sunflower field at sunset that she shared with Nate on 9 November 2022.

entities.name: Tampa
entities.description: The city whose beach Nate took his turtles to on 10 November 2022.

entities.name: Little Women
entities.description: A film about sisterhood, love and reaching for your dreams. Joanna watched it shortly before 7 February 2022 and recommended it to Nate as a must-see; he watched it about eight months later, by 6 October 2022, and thought the acting and the story were great.

entities.name: The Lord of the Rings trilogy
entities.description: The film trilogy Nate named as one of his favourites on 21 April 2022 for its world building, battles and storytelling, and which he calls probably the greatest trilogy of all time. Joanna watched it on 1 May 2022 on his recommendation and thought it awesome.

entities.name: Inception
entities.description: A film Nate saw shortly before 9 October 2022; he said its twists and dream material blew his mind.

entities.name: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive
entities.description: The team shooter Nate won his first video game tournament in, in the week before 21 January 2022, playing with his team; it is his usual competitive game.

entities.name: Street Fighter
entities.description: The fighting game Nate plays a lot with his friends and won a local tournament in — his second tournament win — in the week before 2 May 2022, to his own surprise.

entities.name: Valorant
entities.description: The game of the big tournament whose final Nate reached and won on 5 November 2022; seeing his name as champion was the best feeling.

entities.name: Cyberpunk 2077
entities.description: A game with a futuristic setting and gameplay that Nate had been playing nonstop as of 9 October 2022.

entities.name: Xenoblade Chronicles
entities.description: A Japanese fantasy RPG Nate was playing and recommending in November 2022. He is a big Nintendo fan and had wanted to play it for a while because his friends had recommended it.

entities.name: Catan
entities.description: A strategy board game of building settlements and trading resources that Nate loves. He played it with people he met at a game convention on 7 October 2022; the group competed but stayed relaxed about it.

entities.name: writing
entities.description: Joanna's central practice and, since acting, her main way of expressing herself: screenplays, a book, a blog, a journal and her own memories. She calls it an escape, a way to create wild worlds and characters and to heal, and what gets her through hard times. She reads widely and keeps a bookshelf of books and magazines as her source of inspiration, and gave Nate advice on taking it up in March 2022.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: Joanna's way of resetting and finding inspiration; nature has always been her haven. She found a trail in her hometown in April 2022, more trails and Whispering Falls in May 2022 and declared herself an expert hiker, and hiked with friends in June 2022. Nate is not into hiking but agreed he might try it with her.

entities.name: reading
entities.description: Something both Joanna and Nate enjoy. She reads widely for writing inspiration and rediscovered forgotten books in April 2022; he has shelves of books he has not read in years. They trade book and series recommendations, including a fantasy series each way in August 2022.

entities.name: watching movies
entities.description: A hobby Joanna and Nate share and the thing they most often recommend to each other. Joanna likes dramas and romcoms and getting immersed in the feelings and plots; Nate likes action, science fiction and fantasy for the effects and the escape. Both say films take you to new worlds and make you feel things you would not otherwise.

entities.name: video gaming
entities.description: Nate's main hobby and, from 2022, his career: competitive video game tournaments, plus board games and playing with friends. He calls games his escape from life's struggles and does not get very competitive about them. Joanna is not into games.

entities.name: acting
entities.description: Joanna's first passion, before writing. She was so nervous in her first play that she forgot her lines, which taught her to prepare and stay in the moment. She now shines in writing but has not ruled out returning to acting.

entities.name: making dairy-free desserts

properties.aliases: vegan desserts, dairy-free baking, coconut milk ice cream

entities.description: Making dairy-free and vegan sweets, above all coconut milk ice cream. Nate discovered he could make it in February 2022 and it became his signature, taught on his cooking show in September 2022. Joanna, who is lactose intolerant, built a repertoire of dairy-free cakes, tarts and cupcakes through 2022 for her family and friends. It is the thing the two of them most often trade recipes about.

entities.name: Joanna's animal allergy
entities.description: Joanna's severe allergy to most reptiles and to animals with fur — her face becomes puffy and itchy — which is why she keeps no pets and why her family had to rehome her dog Tilly. She learned shortly before 18 March 2022 that she is allergic to cockroaches as well, and by 20 May 2022 had given up on finding a pet she could keep.

entities.name: Joanna's lactose intolerance
entities.description: Joanna cannot have dairy, which is why every dessert she makes and every recipe she asks Nate for is dairy-free, and why she uses coconut or almond milk.

entities.name: Joanna's cork board
entities.description: A board of quotes, photographs and keepsakes in Joanna's room that she calls her little corner of inspiration. It carries a family photograph that reminds her daily of her family's love and encouragement. Nate said in June 2022 that he should start one of his own.

entities.name: Nate's gaming setup
entities.description: Nate's home gaming room and computer, where he practises, competes and plays with friends. He showed it to Joanna in May 2022 and upgraded the equipment in November 2022, calling it his own little haven and essential to his career because without it he could never beat his competition.

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Asked on 24 March 2022 by Nate, who wanted to pursue writing, for advice, Joanna said to read a lot across different genres, build a solid understanding of literature, not be afraid to write and share even if only with friends, practise and gather feedback, and have faith in yourself.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna and Nate agreed on 24 March 2022 to keep working hard towards their dreams and to keep supporting each other.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: On 3 June 2022 Joanna remarked that she had been hearing about Nate's tournaments for years, and he agreed it had been a long while since his first one.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Some of the gamers Nate talked to after the regional tournament in the week before 3 June 2022 wanted to hang out later and asked him for tips on improving their game, which he agreed to give because he likes helping people.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna planned to hike a new trail with a waterfall together with friends over the weekend of 4 and 5 June 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was organising a gaming party for the weekend of 18 June 2022, planning to invite his tournament friends along with old friends and teammates from other tournaments, and to give everyone custom controller decorations for coming.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: A screenplay Joanna wrote parts of appeared on the big screen on 4 June 2022; she found it nerve-wracking but inspiring to see her words come alive.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Spider-Man is Joanna's favourite superhero, because she loves Peter Parker's struggle between being a hero and being a person, though she likes any superhero for their own story and powers; Nate had noticed a Spider-Man pin on her purse the last time they met.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Iron Man is Nate's favourite superhero, for his technology and sarcastic humour; he keeps an Iron Man figure in his room because it reminds him of something he loves and keeps him working on his goals.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna keeps a cork board full of inspiring quotes, photographs and little keepsakes in her room, which she calls her little corner of inspiration.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: A photograph of her family on Joanna's cork board reminds her every day of their love and encouragement, which she says means a lot and keeps her going.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate said on 5 June 2022 that he should start a cork board of his own, and Joanna recommended it as long as he was willing to explain it to his friends.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna submitted her most recent screenplay to a film contest on 24 June 2022, to see how others might like it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's gaming party in June 2022 was a great success, and the group played Chess afterwards just for fun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Most of Nate's guests liked the custom controller accessories he gave them, though he could not say whether they would all keep using them; he and Joanna agreed that the thought was what mattered.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Seven people came to Nate's gaming party in June 2022 and six of them said they would want to do it again the following month.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate made vegan ice cream on 17 June 2022 and shared it with some people from his vegan diet group.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate agreed on 24 June 2022 to give Joanna his vegan ice cream recipe the next day, and she planned to make it for her family that weekend; her family love it when she makes them new things.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won his fourth video game tournament on 8 July 2022; this one was online, the victory was indescribable, and he said he was proud to be making money doing what he loves.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna took a road trip for research for her next film shortly before 10 July 2022, which was a much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's research road trip in July 2022 took her to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest, where she saw lovely scenery and historic buildings and visited the library for its collection of old books.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In Woodhaven library Joanna found a book from the 1900s of stories and sketches about the town and the people who lived there; Woodhaven's interesting past and how much it had changed sparked ideas for her next script.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 10 July 2022 that the new script she was excited about would be different from her previous work but had the potential to be something awesome.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna started writing a book around 10 July 2022, after her movie did well; it is a deep, emotional story exploring loss, redemption and forgiveness, and it would be the first book she had tried to publish.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: By 14 August 2022 Joanna was busy with writing projects and going all out with them, through a mix of highs and lows, with her journal as her rock; writing had become a huge part of her, an escape and a way to put her thoughts and feelings down and make something good out of them.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In the week before 14 August 2022 someone wrote Joanna a letter after reading a blog post she had published online about a hard moment in her life, saying her story had brought them comfort; realising her words had that power reminded her why she loves writing and keeps her going on tough days.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate started teaching people how to make dairy-free desserts in the summer of 2022, and found sharing his love of them fun and rewarding.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate had a new dairy-free dessert recipe in August 2022 that he described as creamy, rich and dairy-free, and he sent it to Joanna on 14 August 2022; she planned to surprise her family with it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate won an international video game tournament on 21 August 2022 and said gaming had brought him so much success that he was now able to make a living from something he is passionate about.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's turtles got a new, larger tank by 22 August 2022, which gave them much more room and made them happy; he says they are calm and peaceful and make coming home after a long day of gaming better.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna shared her book with her writers group in the week before 22 August 2022; she was very nervous but got great feedback, felt her hard work was paying off, and celebrated by making a dessert.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate planned to take the weekend of 27 August 2022 off to relax with his pets while Joanna planned a long walk and some reading; both said that taking breaks and looking after yourself matter for inspiration, mental health and creativity, and that it is all about balance.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On 22 August 2022 Joanna recommended that Nate find a fantasy book series to read, saying most fiction series are great reads when you are trying to relax, and he picked one out from his shelves.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate recommended a book series with awesome battles and interesting characters to Joanna on 22 August 2022, one of his favourites, and she said she would add it to her list.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate did badly in a video game tournament shortly before 5 September 2022 despite trying; he called it a setback and part of the learning curve and was trying to stay positive, and said spending time with his turtles had been a big help.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna revised one of her old dessert recipes shortly before 5 September 2022; tinkering with that recipe and a few others was giving her comfort and a way to get creative.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna was experimenting with chocolate, raspberry and coconut flavours in September 2022, using coconut or almond milk because she is lactose intolerant, and made dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: By September 2022 Joanna was making cookies, pies and cakes that suit everyone's diets, promised to share more recipes with Nate, and agreed he could join her in the kitchen sometime.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's tips for dairy-free baking, given to Joanna on 5 September 2022, are to use dairy-free margarine or coconut oil instead of butter and to check labels to make sure ingredients really are dairy-free.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's laptop crashed in the week before 14 September 2022 and she lost all her work with nothing recoverable, which was a major blow because as a writer her laptop is half her lifeline; she has since bought an external drive for backups.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate taught people vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show on Monday 12 September 2022; it was nerve-wracking to put himself out there but a blast, and he picked up a few new recipes.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Coconut milk ice cream is Nate's favourite dish from his cooking show: smooth and creamy with a tropical coconut twist, and dairy-free for people who cannot have lactose or who want vegan options. He agreed on 14 September 2022 to share the recipe with Joanna.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna made a delicious dessert with almond milk on 9 September 2022, and says dairy-free is a must for her, especially for desserts.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Besides coconut milk ice cream, Nate's favourite dairy-free dessert is a chocolate mousse he says is super creamy and tastes like the real thing.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's favourite dairy-free treat is a chocolate raspberry tart with an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache and fresh raspberries.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna makes a dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries out of almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate and raspberries, which she calls moist and perfectly sweet and reserves for birthdays and special days.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna also makes a creamy dessert of blueberries, coconut milk and a gluten-free crust, whose recipe she shared with Nate on 14 September 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna tried her newest dairy-free recipe on 5 October 2022 and it was a winner with her family; she enjoys mixing and matching flavours and is always trying new things.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won a really big video game tournament in the week before 6 October 2022 and made a lot of money from it; he saved some but was unsure what to do with it because he is completely content already, and enjoyed no longer having to stress about money.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate watched Little Women shortly before 6 October 2022, eight months after Joanna recommended it to him, and thought the acting awesome and the story captivating; Joanna said its themes of sisterhood, love and chasing dreams really spoke to her.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished writing her book in the week before 6 October 2022, after a ton of late nights and edits, and said she was proud of it and could not wait to see what happened next.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 6 October 2022 that she would not give up on her goals as long as Nate was there to support her, and he told her she could always count on him.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate made Joanna a hand-drawn encouragement board on 6 October 2022 so she could look back on it whenever she needed encouragement, saying her life path is inspirational and that encouragement was what got him so far in his gaming career.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna made a bookmark for one of the women at her writing club shortly before 6 October 2022; she absolutely loves DIY projects and knows the recipient does too.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate went to a game convention on 7 October 2022 and met new people from outside his normal circle; it was a bit overwhelming but reminded him of the good times gaming can bring, and he and Joanna agreed it is good to step outside your comfort zone.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: At the game convention on 7 October 2022 Nate made friends who love games as he does, and they had already planned a gaming session together.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: At the convention Nate joined some people playing a board game he loves, found he had a lot in common with them and hit it off, and said it is great when a shared hobby bonds people.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: The board game Nate played at the convention on 7 October 2022 was Catan, a strategy game of building settlements and trading resources that he loves; the group competed but stayed relaxed and had fun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate says playing games is his escape from life's struggles, so he does not get crazily competitive about them, and the people at the October 2022 convention were the same way.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate suggested on 9 October 2022 that Joanna go to a writing convention, and she said she would look into whether such things exist because it could be fun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate spends his evenings at home playing video games or watching films to unwind.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate saw the film Inception shortly before 9 October 2022 and said its twists and dream material blew his mind, and he had been playing the game Cyberpunk 2077 nonstop for its futuristic setting and gameplay.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna watched a classic film shortly before 9 October 2022 with a gripping story and great actors that really stuck with her; she rated it 9 or 10 out of 10.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna and Nate agreed on 9 October 2022 that films take you to new worlds, fill you with emotions you would not normally experience, and are a great way to chill out after a day.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's advice to Nate on 9 October 2022 for making a living room comfortable for watching films was a couch big enough to lie down on and really fluffy, a blanket with some weight to it, and lights that can be dimmed; she admits she gets very invested in small things like that.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's competitive gaming changed from a hobby he played for fun in January 2022, through his first tournament win that month and a second at a local Street Fighter event in May 2022, into a career he made a living from by August 2022, when he won an international tournament.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna spent the weeks before 21 October 2022 revising and perfecting the dessert recipe she had made for her family, and it turned out really tasty.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate had been very stressed in October 2022 because of his tournament progress against tough competitors, and said his turtles always cheer him up.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna named the stuffed toy dog Nate gave her Tilly, and keeps her close while she writes.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna named the stuffed dog Tilly after a dog of that name she used to have back in Michigan, whom the family had to rehome when she became allergic; the name reminds her of when she could hold and squeeze an animal without an allergic reaction.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna says the stuffed dog Tilly helps her stay focused and brings her a lot of joy, and Nate said he is not sure he will ever understand why watching his turtles slowly walk around makes him so happy, but is very glad it does.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was practising for his next video game tournament as of 21 October 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna had another rejection from a production company shortly before 21 October 2022, for the script she had sent to a film contest; she said it was hard but that she would keep grinding and would not let it slow her down.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Another movie script Joanna contributed to was shown on the big screen for the first time on 23 October 2022 — the third time this had happened for her — and she found it surreal and satisfying after waiting a long time to see her characters and dialogue acted out.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's favourite part of seeing her script on the big screen in October 2022 was watching the characters she had worked so hard on come alive, as though they had jumped off the page and become real.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna draws visuals of her characters to bring them alive in her head so she can write them better, and takes ideas for them from people she knows, things she has seen and things she has imagined.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna refused on 25 October 2022 to tell Nate about one of the characters in her drawings, telling him to watch the movie and find out, which made him keener to see it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate took his turtles out for a walk on 25 October 2022 because he was bored, and afterwards they rested in their tank, tired from all the walking.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's turtles eat a varied diet of vegetables, fruit and insects, and he most loves watching them eat fruit because they get so excited about it; he also likes holding them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's turtles have distinct personalities — one more adventurous, the other more reserved — and he says they bring him joy and make great companions; he has liked turtles since he was a boy and knows all about them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna set up meetings with movie producers and held them shortly before 4 November 2022; they went really well, she felt confident discussing her script and her vision, the producers seemed interested and loved the elements of self-discovery in it, and being taken seriously left her hopeful and inspired.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna found old notebooks of her early writing in the week before 4 November 2022, and enjoyed seeing how far she had come as an artist.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna still remembers a story she wrote when she was ten, about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway, and thinks she was already drawn then to stories about finding courage and taking risks, as she still is.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna says turtles make her think of strength and perseverance and help motivate her in tough times, and Nate reaffirmed on 4 November 2022 that he loves turtles.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Besides her producer meetings, Joanna was working on a project in November 2022 that she found challenging but fulfilling.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate spent early November 2022 helping friends reset their high scores at the international tournament, and said it felt good to use his skills to make a difference.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate made lactose-free coconut milk ice cream on 3 November 2022 and invited Joanna over to try it; she arranged to come on 5 November 2022 and to bring her own recipes so they could share desserts, and Nate said he had been wanting to try her chocolate and raspberry cake.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate reached the final of a big Valorant tournament on 5 November 2022 and won it; seeing his name as the champion was the best feeling, and he says tournaments bring out strong emotions in him.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished the presentation of her script for producers on 4 November 2022; it was tough but it was looking good.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was busy preparing for further tournaments in November 2022 and loving it, and said he is really grateful to have a job he enjoys every day.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna was writing another movie script in November 2022, a love story with lots of challenges that she hoped to get on the big screen; she got the idea for it from a dream.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate said on 7 November 2022 that his turtles were doing great and that watching them is calming and fascinating, and Joanna said that creating stories and watching them come alive is what gives her happiness and fulfilment.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna submitted several more scripts in the week before 7 November 2022 and expected a few to be rejected, but promised Nate she would not give up.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate upgraded some of his home gaming equipment in early November 2022; the computer is where he practises, competes and plays games with friends, and he calls the setup his own little haven and says it is important to his career because without it he could never beat his competition.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate was playing the Japanese fantasy RPG Xenoblade Chronicles in November 2022 and recommending it; he is a big fan of Nintendo games and had wanted to play this one for a while because his friends had recommended it, and he values Joanna's film recommendations for the same reason.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna opened the intro of her next movie script with a letter her brother wrote her when they were children; he used to make her such notes, and it brings back sweet memories of simpler times.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate had a special day in 2022 taking his pets to the park, where their happy faces made it memorable, and he says mixing new memories with old ones is priceless.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna started writing down her favourite memories by 7 November 2022, and Nate said he would start doing the same, both for the things his animals like and for his favourite memories with her.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's game tournament was pushed back in the week before 9 November 2022, so he tried some cooking instead and made homemade coconut ice cream, whose colour the sprinkles changed this time.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate did not make it to the finals of his last tournament before 9 November 2022, calling it a tough one, but stayed positive about getting them next time.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate was thinking of joining a new gaming team after his next tournament as of 9 November 2022; he had had a few offers but had not decided, and called it a big step he was ready for.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna worked out a plan for getting another of her scripts made into a movie and pitched it to producers on 8 November 2022; they really liked it, which gave her a big confidence boost and left her feeling she could not stop writing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's new project as of 9 November 2022 is a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town, which she calls a great creative outlet.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate started creating gaming content for YouTube in November 2022, as a way to entertain people and satisfy his video game cravings between tournaments and to connect with others who enjoy gaming; he was already watching other people's videos first, which was also Joanna's advice.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna photographed a sunflower field at sunset on a hike near Fort Wayne in the summer of 2022, and shared the picture with Nate on 9 November 2022 as a reminder of nature's beauty.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate got a third turtle shortly before 9 November 2022, after seeing it at a pet store and deciding the tank was now big enough for three; he says turtles bring him joy and peace and that he is very happy with the decision.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna arranged on 9 November 2022 to visit Nate the next day to watch him play with his turtles from a distance because of her allergy; they also planned to watch one of her movies together or go to the park, and Nate said he would bath the turtles first.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: By 11 November 2022 Joanna was filming her own movie from her road-trip script; she said it was wild to see it come alive, that every day on set was full of potential, and that being able to show her vision was wonderful.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: The coolest moment on set for Joanna was one of the actors telling her how much she liked the script, which gave her chills.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate took his turtles to the beach in Tampa on 10 November 2022; he says they always bring him peace in the craziness of life.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate loves having his turtles around because they make him feel calm, need little looking after and look serene soaking in the sun; he calls them zen masters who remind him to slow down and appreciate the small things in life.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate was experimenting with coconut milk ice cream flavours and mix-ins in November 2022 and offered Joanna the recipe that jazzes it up, which she accepted.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's screenwriting went from finishing and printing her first screenplay on 21 January 2022, through festival submissions and rejections from a major company and a production company, to three scripts she contributed to reaching the big screen during 2022 and, by 11 November 2022, filming her own movie from her road-trip script.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's household of pets grew through 2022, from the two turtles he had kept for about three years, to an adopted dog called Max in May 2022, to a third turtle in November 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's dairy-free dessert making developed from first trying coconut milk ice cream in February 2022, through sharing vegan ice cream with his diet group in June 2022 and teaching the recipes on his own cooking show in September 2022, to experimenting with new flavours and mix-ins in November 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's book went from being started around 10 July 2022, through being shared nervously with her writers group in August 2022 for feedback, to the writing being finished in the week before 6 October 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's hiking grew from discovering a trail in her hometown in April 2022, to finding more trails and Whispering Falls in May 2022 and calling herself an expert hiker, to hiking a new waterfall trail with friends in June 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna
